task.description:
WF-03 Step 1 — root-cause diagnosis for ISS-0123 / GitHub #389.

Use fn:search-issues first. Then read the relevant source files to confirm/refine the root-cause hypothesis already documented in docs/issues/ISS-0123.json. The issue has TWO intertwined clusters:

CLUSTER A — Audit-trigger P0001 ('audit_entries is immutable' from bpm_audit_immutable_guard)
  - Read src/db/audit.zig and migrations/GBL-102_audit_immutability.sql + migrations/GBL-103_audit_immutability_guard.sql
  - Read tests/integration/audit_iss103_test.zig and the GBL-103/GBL-102-triggering helpers in tests/integration/helpers.zig
  - Confirm: is the P0001 raised because tests INTENTIONALLY trip the guard, or because of an actual production-code bug?
  - Confirm: the audit-guard test paths use a dedicated transaction that doesn't leak into neighboring tests

CLUSTER B — source_ref C42703 (column does not exist)
  - Read src/events/store.zig — every INSERT statement must list only columns that exist in the canonical event_store schema
  - Check migrations that define event_store (search for CREATE TABLE event_store in migrations/)
  - Find every tests/integration/iss202_merge_atomicity_test.zig, iss203_idempotency_keys_test.zig, iss205_webhook_outbox_test.zig reference to a source_ref column. Use ripgrep:
      rg -n "source_ref" tests/integration/iss202_merge_atomicity_test.zig tests/integration/iss203_idempotency_keys_test.zig tests/integration/iss205_webhook_outbox_test.zig src/events/store.zig
  - Read scratch/WF03-gh375-20260801/test-runner-step5c/zig_test_integration.log at offsets 1480582 and 1480767 to confirm the C42703 error is from a test INSERT statement (not from a production code path)
  - Cross-reference the canonical event_store schema (look at \\d+ event_store in the migration that creates it) to see whether source_ref was ever a column or never existed at all

Produce a written diagnosis at docs/issue-reports/ISS-0123-root-cause.md (YAML format per CLAUDE.md output rules — use .yaml extension) with:
  - symptom (verbatim error from log: both P0001 and C42703 messages)
  - root cause (file:line refs for each cluster)
  - candidate fix strategies (e.g. a: add a column to event_store; b: remove source_ref from test INSERTs; c: both), with a recommendation
  - acceptance criteria for the fix (concrete, testable)
  - linked evidence (log offsets, file:line refs)

Also update docs/issues/ISS-0123.json:
  - Refine root_cause with concrete file:line refs from your diagnosis
  - Set candidate_resolution to the recommended strategy
  - Set resolution to null (still unresolved)
  - Do NOT mark resolved_at

Do NOT implement the fix yet. Diagnosis only.
acceptance_criteria: docs/issues/ISS-0123.json root_cause refined with file:line refs
Recommendation stated: e.g. "remove source_ref from test INSERTs" or "add column to event_store"
Acceptance criteria for the fix are concrete and testable (which tests must pass, with specific TCs)

result.summary: Diagnosed ISS-0123 / GitHub #389. The handoff hypothesis (src/db/audit.zig + iss202/203/205 source_ref drift) was incorrect; actual root cause is in the DLQ subsystem: (A) src/dlq/store.zig and tests reference legacy table name `dead_letter_queue` (renamed to `dead_letter_items` by migration 072 but production/test code was never updated) — PostgreSQL C42703 (source_ref / item_type column missing) fires on every INSERT in obs05_dlq_test + obs06_alerts_test. (B) tests/integration/obs05_dlq_test.zig:TC-OBS-05-INT-01 lines 427-449 install trg_bpm_test_fail_audit_insert without a savepoint wrapper; the cleanup defer only runs on the happy path, so the trigger leaks into adp09_tamper_evident_audit_chain_test:TC-ADP-09-01 and oidc16_26_agent_lifecycle_foundations_test:TC-OIDC-22-01 where it fires P0001 audit_entries is immutable on legitimate mutations. Recommended fix: rename `dead_letter_queue` to `dead_letter_items` in src/dlq/store.zig (11 sites) + the two DLQ test files, and add unconditional trigger cleanup in obs05_dlq_test.
